slug: 2025-12-01 Biometric Digital-ID in Africa - Ten Country Case Studies
note: Passages file; the one passage on Egypt concerns the national ID card (civil registration offices take fingerprints and a photo and save them in the computer system; collecting criminal-record data is barred save where law specifies). The other passages are Liberia, Namibia and Botswana. No police system and nothing on station records for Egypt.
